check_copyright_notices: check all source files for missing copyright notices and Apache 2 license headers
insert_copyright_notice: insert a copyright notice and Apache 2 license into files missing them for a given author
replace_mit_license: replace MIT or Khronos free use license blocks with Apache 2 license in source files
find_filtered_files: find files matching a glob pattern while skipping third_party and build directories
comment_text_block: prefix each line of a text block with a comment character and a space
